title: Add platform feature-flag helper and middleware
acceptance: WHEN `isFeatureEnabled` gets no `feature_flags` row for a key THE SYSTEM SHALL return `true` (default-open).
WHEN `isFeatureEnabled` gets a row with `enabled: false` THE SYSTEM SHALL return `false`, and for `enabled: true` SHALL return `true`.

WHEN a request passes `requireFeatureEnabled('ANALYTICS')` while that row has `enabled: false` THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 503 `{ error: 'Esta funcionalidad está deshabilitada temporalmente. Intenta de nuevo más tarde.', code: 'FEATURE_DISABLED' }` and SHALL NOT call `next`.
WHEN the flag row is missing or the lookup throws THE SYSTEM SHALL call `next()` exactly once, and on a throw SHALL log `Feature flag lookup failed, treating as enabled` at warn.
WHEN `(cd backend && npm run build)` runs and `node` requires the built `dist/modules/platform/application/isFeatureEnabled.js` THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0.

acceptance: WHEN the `NOTIFICATIONS` flag row has `enabled: false` and an authenticated `POST /api/v1/notifications/telegram/link-code` arrives THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 503 with `code: 'FEATURE_DISABLED'` and SHALL NOT write to `users`.
WHEN the `NOTIFICATIONS` flag row has `enabled: false` and an authenticated `POST /api/v1/notifications/test` arrives THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 503 with `code: 'FEATURE_DISABLED'`.
WHEN the `NOTIFICATIONS` flag is disabled and the request has no `Authorization` header THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 401, because the existing auth chain runs before the flag check.
WHEN no `NOTIFICATIONS` row exists THE SYSTEM SHALL issue a link code with status 200, and `NotificationsRoutes.test.ts` and the whole `src/modules/notifications` suite SHALL exit 0.

WHEN `backend/src/modules/notifications/presentation/routes.ts` is compared with the previous step THE SYSTEM SHALL show zero removed lines and exactly 2 lines reading `  requireNotificationsEnabled,`.

title: Gate analytics routes behind ANALYTICS
acceptance: WHEN each of the 12 analytics `GET` routes is called with a session whose plan grants `USE_ANALYTICS` and no `ANALYTICS` flag row exists THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 200 from the controller.
WHEN the `ANALYTICS` flag row has `enabled: false` THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 503 with `code: 'FEATURE_DISABLED'` to an authorized `GET /api/v1/analytics/contracts/trends`.
WHEN the session user's plan lacks `USE_ANALYTICS` THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 403 `{ error: 'Forbidden: Requires USE_ANALYTICS capability' }`, even while the flag is disabled.
WHEN no `Authorization` header is sent THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 401 `{ error: 'Missing or invalid Authorization header' }`.

WHEN `backend/src/modules/analytics/presentation/routes.ts` is searched THE SYSTEM SHALL find exactly 12 lines containing `requireAnalytics, requireAnalyticsEnabled, (req, res)` and the unchanged line `const requireAnalytics = requireCapability('USE_ANALYTICS');`.

title: Add API key format, hashing and typed errors
acceptance: WHEN `generateApiKey()` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL return a `plaintext` matching `^ck_live_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$`, a `keyPrefix` equal to its first 12 characters, and a `keyHash` equal to the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the plaintext.
WHEN `generateApiKey()` runs twice THE SYSTEM SHALL return two different plaintexts and two different hashes.

WHEN `isApiKeyAuthorization` receives `Bearer ck_live_abc` THE SYSTEM SHALL return `true`, and for a `Bearer eyJ…` JWT, a missing header, a token without the `Bearer ` prefix, a lowercase `bearer ` prefix or a `Basic` header SHALL return `false`.

WHEN `ApiKeyAuthenticationError`, `ApiAccessNotAllowedError` and `ApiKeyNotFoundError` are constructed THE SYSTEM SHALL expose `code` `INVALID_API_KEY`, `API_ACCESS_NOT_IN_PLAN` and `API_KEY_NOT_FOUND` respectively, each with a `name` equal to its class name.
WHEN `(cd backend && npm run build)` runs and `node` requires the built `dist/modules/identity/domain/ApiKey.js` THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0.

title: Map API-key users with CurrentUserResolver parity
acceptance: WHEN the mapper receives a user whose non-FREE plan has a future `planExpiresAt` THE SYSTEM SHALL take `plan`, `maxFavoriteEntities`, `capabilities` and `apiRequestsPerMinute` from that plan and SHALL NOT call `loadFreePlan`.

WHEN the user's non-FREE plan has expired, or the user has no plan, THE SYSTEM SHALL set `plan: 'FREE'` and take `maxFavoriteEntities`, `capabilities` and `apiRequestsPerMinute` from the FREE plan `loadFreePlan` returns.
WHEN `loadFreePlan` returns `null` THE SYSTEM SHALL set `plan: 'FREE'`, `maxFavoriteEntities: 0`, `capabilities: []` and `apiRequestsPerMinute: null`.

WHEN `CurrentUserResolver.resolve` and the mapper receive the same database user in each of the active, expired and no-plan states THE SYSTEM SHALL produce equal `plan`, `maxFavoriteEntities`, `capabilities`, `planExpiresAt`, `phone`, `telegramUsername`, `notifyEmail`, `notifyTelegram` and `notifySms`.
WHEN the mapper builds a user THE SYSTEM SHALL set `id`, `email` and `roles` from the database row and `permissions: []`, and SHALL NOT set `organizationId`.
WHEN `(cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit)` and `CurrentUserResolver.test.ts` run THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0, with `CurrentUserResolver.ts` and `AuthenticatedUser.ts` unchanged since the previous step.
verify: git rev-parse --verify -q HEAD >/dev/null && git diff --quiet HEAD -- backend/src/modules/identity/presentation/CurrentUserResolver.ts backend/src/modules/identity/domain/AuthenticatedUser.ts

title: Authenticate API keys in ApiKeyService
acceptance: WHEN `authenticate` receives a token that does not match `^ck_live_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$` THE SYSTEM SHALL throw `ApiKeyAuthenticationError` without querying `api_keys`.
WHEN the SHA-256 of a well-formed key matches no row, or the matching row has `revokedAt` set, THE SYSTEM SHALL throw `ApiKeyAuthenticationError`.

WHEN the key belongs to an active `BUSINESS` user THE SYSTEM SHALL look it up by `keyHash` with the user, plan and capabilities included, and return `apiKeyId`, a user with `plan: 'BUSINESS'` whose capabilities include `USE_API`, and `apiRequestsPerMinute: 60`.
WHEN the owner's paid plan has expired and the FREE fallback lacks `USE_API`, or the owner's active plan lacks `USE_API`, THE SYSTEM SHALL throw `ApiAccessNotAllowedError`.
WHEN `recordUsage(id)` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL update that key's `lastUsedAt` to the injected clock's time.
WHEN `(cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit)` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0, proving the Prisma include result satisfies `UserWithPlan`.

title: Issue, list and revoke API keys in ApiKeyService
acceptance: WHEN `issue(userId, 'CI')` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL call `apiKey.create` with `data` holding exactly `userId`, `name`, `keyHash` and `keyPrefix`, and SHALL return `{ id, name, keyPrefix, createdAt, key }` where `key` matches `^ck_live_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$`, its SHA-256 hex equals the stored `keyHash`, and `keyPrefix` is its first 12 characters.
WHEN `listForUser(userId)` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL query `where: { userId }` ordered by `createdAt` descending, selecting only `id`, `name`, `keyPrefix`, `createdAt`, `lastUsedAt` and `revokedAt`.
WHEN `revoke(userId, id)` targets a key that does not exist or belongs to another user THE SYSTEM SHALL throw `ApiKeyNotFoundError` and SHALL NOT call `apiKey.update`.
WHEN `revoke` targets the caller's active key THE SYSTEM SHALL set `revokedAt` to the injected clock's time and return the updated summary.
WHEN `revoke` targets the caller's already-revoked key THE SYSTEM SHALL return the existing summary and SHALL NOT call `apiKey.update`.
WHEN `ApiKeyService.test.ts` and `(cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit)` run THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0.

title: Add ApiKeyAuthMiddleware
acceptance: WHEN the `API_ACCESS` flag is disabled THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 503 `{ error: 'Esta funcionalidad está deshabilitada temporalmente. Intenta de nuevo más tarde.', code: 'FEATURE_DISABLED' }` before authenticating any key.
WHEN authentication throws `ApiKeyAuthenticationError` THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 401 `{ error: 'La clave de API es inválida o fue revocada.', code: 'INVALID_API_KEY' }` and SHALL NOT call `next`.
WHEN authentication throws `ApiAccessNotAllowedError` THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 403 `{ error: 'Tu plan actual no incluye acceso por API.', code: 'API_ACCESS_NOT_IN_PLAN' }`.

WHEN authentication succeeds THE SYSTEM SHALL set `req.user` to the resolved `AuthenticatedUser`, set `req.apiKey` to `{ id, apiRequestsPerMinute }`, call `next()` once, and call `recordUsage` with the key id.

WHEN `recordUsage` rejects THE SYSTEM SHALL still call `next()` and SHALL log `API key usage timestamp update failed` at warn; WHEN any other error is thrown THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 500 `{ error: 'Internal Server Error' }`.
WHEN `(cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit)` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0.

title: Add the per-API-key rate limiter
acceptance: WHEN a key whose plan allows 2 requests per minute sends 3 requests within the window THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 200, 200 and then 429 with `{ error: 'Demasiadas solicitudes con esta clave de API. Intenta de nuevo en un minuto.' }`.
WHEN one key has exhausted its limit THE SYSTEM SHALL still answer 200 to a different key, because the counter is keyed by API key id and not by IP.
WHEN a key's plan allows 3 requests per minute THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 200 to its third request, proving the limit is read per request from `req.apiKey.apiRequestsPerMinute`.
WHEN `apiRequestsPerMinute` is `null`, `0` or absent THE SYSTEM SHALL apply the fallback limit of 10.
WHEN `(cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit)` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0.

title: Add authenticateApiKeyOrSession entry point
acceptance: WHEN a request carries `Authorization: Bearer ck_live_…` THE SYSTEM SHALL run the API-key handlers in order and SHALL NOT run the session handlers.
WHEN a request carries a `Bearer eyJ…` JWT or no `Authorization` header THE SYSTEM SHALL run the session handlers in order and SHALL NOT run the API-key handlers.
WHEN a handler in the chain responds without calling `next` THE SYSTEM SHALL run no later handler, and WHEN an async handler rejects THE SYSTEM SHALL pass the error to Express's error handler.

WHEN `requireSessionAuth` receives an API key THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 403 `{ error: 'Las claves de API no pueden administrar claves de API. Usa tu sesión de la aplicación web.', code: 'SESSION_REQUIRED' }`, and for a JWT SHALL call `next`.

WHEN the wired `authenticateApiKeyOrSession` receives an API key while `API_ACCESS` is disabled THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 503 `code: 'FEATURE_DISABLED'` without looking the key up and without running the session handlers.
WHEN `(cd backend && npm run build)` runs and `node` requires the built `dist/modules/identity/presentation/authenticateApiKeyOrSession.js` THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0.

title: Add ApiKeyController and schemas
acceptance: WHEN `create` runs for an authenticated user with body `{ name: '  ERP  ' }` THE SYSTEM SHALL call `issue` with the trimmed name `ERP` and respond 201 with the issued key object.
WHEN any of `create`, `list` or `revoke` runs without `req.user` THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 401 `{ error: 'Unauthorized' }` and call no service method.
WHEN `list` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 200 `{ apiKeys: [...] }` with the service's summaries.
WHEN `revoke` receives an id that is not UUID-shaped, or the service throws `ApiKeyNotFoundError`, THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 404 `{ error: 'Clave de API no encontrada.', code: 'API_KEY_NOT_FOUND' }`.
WHEN the service throws any other error THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 500 `{ error: 'Internal Server Error' }` and log `API key endpoint error`.
WHEN `(cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit)` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0.

title: Mount session-only /auth/api-keys routes
acceptance: WHEN a BUSINESS session sends `POST /api/v1/auth/api-keys` with `{ name: 'Integración ERP' }` THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 201 with a `key` matching `^ck_live_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$`, a `keyPrefix` equal to its first 12 characters, and no `keyHash` field.
WHEN `POST /api/v1/auth/api-keys` arrives with an API key in `Authorization` THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 403 `code: 'SESSION_REQUIRED'` without verifying a JWT and without creating a key.

WHEN a session whose plan lacks `USE_API` sends the POST THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 403 `{ error: 'Forbidden: Requires USE_API capability' }`, and WHEN the body is `{}` THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 400 `Validation failed`.
WHEN a session sends `GET /api/v1/auth/api-keys` THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 200 `{ apiKeys: [...] }` whose JSON contains no `keyHash`.

WHEN a session sends `DELETE /api/v1/auth/api-keys/<uuid>` for a key it does not own THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 404 `code: 'API_KEY_NOT_FOUND'`; WHEN no `Authorization` is sent THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 401; and `GET /api/v1/auth/me` with a session SHALL still respond 200.

WHEN `backend/src/modules/identity/presentation/routes.ts` is compared with the previous step THE SYSTEM SHALL show zero removed lines, and `(cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit)` and `UpdateProfile.test.ts` SHALL exit 0.
verify: git rev-parse --verify -q HEAD >/dev/null && test -z "$(git diff -U0 HEAD -- backend/src/modules/identity/presentation/routes.ts | grep -E '^-([^-]|$)')"

title: Accept API keys on protected procurement routes
acceptance: WHEN each of the 7 protected procurement routes is called with an active BUSINESS API key THE SYSTEM SHALL reach the controller with `req.user.id` equal to the key owner's id, without verifying a JWT.

WHEN each of the 7 protected routes is called with a session token THE SYSTEM SHALL reach the controller with the session user, and WHEN no `Authorization` is sent THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 401 `{ error: 'Missing or invalid Authorization header' }` exactly as before.

WHEN a revoked API key is used THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 401 `code: 'INVALID_API_KEY'`, and WHEN `API_ACCESS` is disabled THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 503 `code: 'FEATURE_DISABLED'` to the key while a session request to the same route still gets 200.
WHEN each of the 6 public procurement routes is called without `Authorization` THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 200.

WHEN `backend/src/modules/procurement/presentation/routes.ts` is searched THE SYSTEM SHALL find no line `  currentUserResolver.resolve,` and exactly 7 lines `  authenticate,`, and `(cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit)` SHALL exit 0.

title: Accept API keys on analytics routes
acceptance: WHEN each of the 12 analytics routes is called with an active API key whose plan grants `USE_ANALYTICS` and `USE_API` THE SYSTEM SHALL reach the controller with `req.user.id` equal to the key owner's id.

WHEN the API key's plan grants `USE_API` but not `USE_ANALYTICS` THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 403 `{ error: 'Forbidden: Requires USE_ANALYTICS capability' }`, and WHEN it grants `USE_ANALYTICS` but not `USE_API` THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 403 `code: 'API_ACCESS_NOT_IN_PLAN'`.

WHEN the `ANALYTICS` flag is disabled THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 503 `code: 'FEATURE_DISABLED'` to an authorized API key, and WHEN `API_ACCESS` is disabled THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 503 to the key while a session request still gets 200.
WHEN `AnalyticsRoutes.test.ts` runs THE SYSTEM SHALL still pass every step-6 session case (12 routes at 200, 503 with the flag off, 403 without `USE_ANALYTICS`, 401 without `Authorization`).

WHEN `backend/src/modules/analytics/presentation/routes.ts` is searched THE SYSTEM SHALL find no route line containing `authMiddleware.handle, currentUserResolver.resolve, requireAnalytics` and exactly 12 lines containing `authenticate, requireAnalytics, requireAnalyticsEnabled, (req, res)`.
WHEN `(cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit)` and `(cd backend && npm run build)` run THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0, and the build SHALL produce `backend/dist/server.js` and `backend/dist/worker.js`.
verify: status=0; grep -qF 'authMiddleware.handle, currentUserResolver.resolve, requireAnalytics' backend/src/modules/analytics/presentation/routes.ts || status=$?; test "$status" -eq 1
